# openobserve_slo (Data Source)

Reads an existing service level objective, looked up either by `slo_id` or by `name`, along with its current measurement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openobserve_slo" "checkout" {
  name = "checkout_availability"
}

# `status` is null until the first evaluation pass has run — "not yet measured"
# and "measured as zero" are different answers, so the provider does not
# conflate them.
output "budget_remaining_pct" {
  value = data.openobserve_slo.checkout.status.error_budget_remaining
}

output "burning_faster_than_budget" {
  value = try(data.openobserve_slo.checkout.status.burn_rate > 1, false)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `folder_id` (String) Restrict a name lookup to one alert folder. All folders are searched when omitted.
- `name` (String) SLO name. Supply this or `slo_id`.
- `org_id` (String) Organization identifier. Defaults to the provider's `org_id`.
- `slo_id` (String) SLO identifier. Supply this or `name`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) What this objective covers.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the objective is being evaluated.
- `group_by` (List of String) Columns splitting the objective into per-group measurements.
- `id` (String) Data source ID in the format `{org_id}/{slo_id}`.
- `owner` (String) Objective owner.
- `sli_type` (String) Indicator type: `count`, `time_slice`, or `alert`.
- `slice_interval_secs` (Number) Slice width in seconds.
- `status` (Attributes) Current measurement. Null until the first evaluation pass has run — "not yet measured" and "measured as zero" are different answers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))
- `tags` (Set of String) Selection tags on the objective.
- `target` (Number) Target availability as a percentage.
- `window_secs` (Number) Rolling window in seconds.

<a id="nestedatt--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status`

Read-Only:

- `burn_rate` (Number) Current burn rate, in multiples of the budget-neutral rate.
- `computed_at` (Number) When the measurement was last recomputed, in microseconds.
- `coverage` (Number) Fraction of the window actually measured, from 0 to 1.
- `covered_slices` (Number) Number of slices that produced a measurement.
- `error_budget_remaining` (Number) Percentage of the error budget still unspent. Goes negative once the budget is overspent, which is deliberate: -80% is what you need to see after burning 180% of the budget.
- `good` (Number) Good events or slices in the window.
- `no_data` (Boolean) True when coverage sits below the floor. The objective is then frozen — neither healthy nor breached — and every derived figure below is null.
- `sli` (Number) Measured indicator as a percentage. Null while frozen or not yet measured.
- `time_to_exhaust_secs` (Number) Seconds until the budget is exhausted at the current burn. Null when the burn is at or below neutral, because nothing is being exhausted.
- `total` (Number) Total events or slices in the window.
